description: The host resolved to 10.0.0.5 when it was added; before a later connection (probe, manifest pull, policy-data push or tool call) its resolved addresses include 169.254.169.254: the rule is applied again, one refused address refuses the host and the server is unreachable with lastError address_refused. TLS (ca, pinned) is what stops a rebinding name from being trusted; this check only refuses the address.
